code_paths.purpose: Performs preflight validation for Change transactions, ensuring all required fields are present and valid before further processing.
Performs further validation after preflight, specifically for ttFEE transactions, checking field presence and feature flags.
validation_points: ctx.tx.isFieldPresent(...) (field presence validation based on feature flags)

transformations: Checked against tfEnableAmendmentMask if featureLendingProtocol enabled

flow: Transactor::invokePreflight<Change> (returns error if not native or not zero)

transformations: Checked for presence (should be empty/not present)

flow: Transactor::invokePreflight<Change> (returns error if sequence != 0 or previous txn present)
Change::preclaim (returns error if missing or forbidden depending on featureXRPFees)
transformations: Presence required or forbidden depending on feature flag

flow: Change::preclaim (returns error if missing or forbidden depending on featureXRPFees)
transformations: Presence required or forbidden depending on feature flag

description: Implements the Change transactor for the XRPL system, handling special system transactions such as amendments, fee changes, and UNL modifications. Contains logic for preflight, preclaim, and application of these system-level transactions.

test_coverage_notes: Validation logic for Change transactions is typically covered in unit/integration tests for system transactions in the rippled codebase. Look for test files such as 'Change_test.cpp', 'Transactor_test.cpp', or 'SystemTransactions_test.cpp' in the 'src/test' or 'src/test/tx' directories. These should cover valid/invalid Change transactions, field presence/absence, and feature flag toggling. However, coverage gaps may exist for edge cases involving feature flag transitions (e.g., enabling/disabling featureXRPFees or featureLendingProtocol), malformed field values, or rare combinations of forbidden/required fields. Manual review of test assertions is recommended to ensure all validation branches are exercised.

validation_architecture.framework: xrpl transaction processing (custom, not external framework)

validations.error_thrown: return value from preflight0 (NotTEC error code)
validates: Checks if transaction flags are allowed (0 means allow any flags, otherwise tfEnableAmendmentMask if featureLendingProtocol is enabled)
Checks that the source account is zero (must be a system transaction)
Checks that the fee is native (XRP)
Checks that the fee is exactly zero
Checks that no signing public key is present
Checks that no signature is present
Checks that no signers field is present
Checks that previous transaction ID is not present
Checks that the transaction is not applied to an open ledger
Checks that these fields are present when featureXRPFees is enabled
Checks that these fields are NOT present when featureXRPFees is enabled
